note: Re-judged 2026-10-30 (independent auditor) after the user-namespace conversion (d8427e4380): the TestGatewayICMPEchoReply unit gained only `if !userns.Enter(t) { return }` as its first statement and its build tag moved from integration&&linux to linux. userns.Enter (internal/test/userns/userns_linux.go) re-runs the one named test in a fresh user+net+mount namespace and returns false to the parent only when the child reported PASS or SKIP; a failing child, a non-zero exit, or a child that ran nothing calls t.Fatalf, so every assertion below the guard still fails the test when the behaviour breaks. Body otherwise byte-identical. RFC 792 Echo: "The checksum is the 16-bit ones's complement of the one's complement sum of the ICMP message starting with the ICMP Type." Fresh judgement: the reply's checksum must fold to zero, and a request with a deliberately wrong checksum (sequence 2) must never be reflected, beside the valid control; the rejecting branch is Linux's on the address Ze installs (whole-stack rule). Enforced.
